children: SAID ON TUESDAY SEDGMAN, A MEMBER OF THE ACS GROUP

, HAS BEEN APPOINTED AS THE PREFERRED ENGINEERING, PROCUREMENT AND CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT (EPCM) CONTRACTOR FOR THE COLOSSUS RARE EARTH PROJECT IN MINAS GERAIS, BRAZIL, BY VIRIDIS MINING & MINERALS LIMITED
WORK WILL COMMENCE IMMEDIATELY UNDER A BRIDGING PHASE TO PROGRESS CRITICAL DETAILED ENGINEERING DESIGN AND PROCUREMENT ACTIVITIES AHEAD OF THE PROJECT FINAL INVESTMENT DECISION (FID)
FOLLOWING FID, SEDGMAN WILL CONTINUE TO WORK CLOSELY WITH VIRIDIS AND BRAZILIAN ENGINEERING AND PROJECT DELIVERY PARTNER, BLOSSOM CONSULT, TO SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF THE PROJECT
